simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁכֵחַ (H7913) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁכֵחַ (shâkêach) means oblivious First listed occurrence: Isa 65 11.

definitions.full: H7913. shakeach [ שָׁכֵחַ ] adjective forgetting, forgetful ; — plural ק אֶתהַֿר חִים ׳הַשְּׁכֵּ Isa 65:11 they who forget the mountain of my holiness (|| י ׳עֹזְבֵי ); construct א ׳שְׁכֵחֵי Psa 9:8 all nations forgetful of God (compare שֹׁכְחֵי participle, Job 8:13 ; Psa 50:22 ).
